title: Kitadoko — Hair Salon Rebranding
jpTitle: Kitadoko — ヘアサロン・リブランディング

summary.en: Rebranded a 150-year-old underground family barbershop — 90% male clientele, zero repeat customers — into a modern salon for women and younger clients. Started with a business-model redesign anchored on the idea 'Kitadoko as a group of personal hair stylists,' then built identity, service flow and renovated interiors from it.
summary.jp: 150 年続く理容店は地下にあり、客の 9 割が男性でリピーターはゼロだった。まずロゴでなく事業の形から考え直した。「北床は専属美容師の集まり」という一言に軸を定め、内装まで作り直した。

business.en: A rebrand that started with the business model, not the logo: an innovation bootcamp and journey mapping came first, and every visual decision — identity, letterforms, renovated space — was derived from one repositioning idea afterward.
business.jp: ロゴから始めない改革。まず事業内容の設計から入り、動線を書き出した。1 つの言い換えを軸に、ロゴも内装もすべて導いた。

mine: Ran an innovation bootcamp with the CEO and journey-mapped the business before any aesthetic work
Redesigned the business model around ongoing customer relationships rather than one-off haircuts
Anchored the strategy on the tagline 'Kitadoko as a group of personal hair stylists' — positioning the salon as people, not a place
Derived the identity, letterforms, service flow and renovated interior from that one idea
Led brand direction, business-model redesign, service design and visual identity
team: Client leadership team and an interior design company — credited on the page without individual task breakdown

metrics.basis: as reported on the case-study page

label.en: monthly visits per stylist, up from 30
label.jp: 月間来店、1 人 30→200 件

narrative.problem: A 150-year-old family barbershop, underground and invisible from the street — 90% male clientele, zero repeat customers. The new owner wanted to transform it into a modern salon that women and younger clients would choose.

business: Repeat customer rate rose from 0% to 90%
Customer satisfaction rose to 91% (4–5★), up from 62%
Monthly visits per stylist rose to 200, up from 30
Female clientele rose to 50%, up from 10%

_notes: No explicit year on the page beyond the salon's own 1871 heritage.
Engagement recorded as freelance based on roles.json's cie evidence list, which includes kitadoko.

cardLine.en: A 150-year-old barbershop with no repeat customers, rebuilt as a salon.
cardLine.jp: 常連がいなかった 150 年続く床屋を、サロンとして建て直した。
